name: Alternating Soles
description: Alternate which foot rests on top of the ball, swapping cleanly each beat.

name: Ball Stop-Start
description: Stop the ball with the sole, then push it gently and stop it again.

name: Box Dribble
description: Push the ball clockwise around four zones, controlling each corner with a clean touch.

name: Complex Zigzag
description: Weave through every zone with feints, finishing back at home in eight beats.

name: Cross-Cut
description: Push the ball across the body, sell the run, then cut hard back the other way.

name: Cruyff Turn
description: Plant outside foot, drag the ball behind it with the inside, and rotate the hips.

name: Cut and Go
description: Sharp lateral cut to change line, then push the ball forward into space.

name: Diagonal Steps
description: Step diagonally across the mat, then return, to learn cross-grid movement.

name: Diagonal Touches
description: Push the ball diagonally across the grid, controlling at each corner.

name: Double Scissors
description: Two crisp step-overs in succession before pushing the ball away.

name: Drag Back
description: Drag the ball back under the body with the sole and reset to home position.

name: Elastico
description: Touch the ball with the outside of the foot, then snap it back with the inside.

name: Figure-Eight
description: Trace a figure-eight around the grid, weaving the ball through each zone.

name: Flip-Flap
description: Rivelino's flick: snap the ball one way with the inside, then back with the outside.

name: Foot Fire
description: Rapid alternating plants on home zone to build foot speed and a low athletic base.

name: Forward-Back Steps
description: Step forward into the far row and back, building a clean push-off and recovery.

name: Heel-Toe Taps
description: Combine top-of-ball taps with quick plants for a syncopated touch pattern.

name: Home Base Touches
description: Both feet take turns touching the home-zone ball with a clean plant on the other.

name: Hop Step-Overs
description: Step over the ball while hopping on the plant foot, then attack with the other.

name: Inside-Outside Roll
description: Alternate inside and outside touches on the ball, building both edges of the foot.

name: Inside-Outside feet switching
description: Extend the inside-outside pattern by moving your foot between zones, combining ball travel with precise touch alternation.

name: Inside-Outside
description: Shift the ball laterally using the inside and outside of the same foot in a steady rhythm. Foundation drill for developing touch variety.

name: Inside Touches
description: Light inside-of-foot touches against a stationary ball, alternating feet.

name: L-Drag
description: Drag the ball forward then sharply sideways, tracing an L on the mat.

name: Lateral Cuts
description: Sharp lateral cuts, switching the ball between left and right feet on each beat.

name: Lateral Shuffle
description: Shuffle laterally across the mat, leading with one foot then the other.

name: Lift and Plant
description: Lift each foot in turn while the other plants firmly, building rhythm and proprioception.

name: Maradona Spin
description: Sole-roll the ball and spin 360 degrees over it, finishing facing the same way.

name: Marseille Roulette
description: Plant on the ball with one sole, spin, then drag away with the other sole.

name: Matthews Feint
description: Show the ball one way with the inside, then burst past with the outside of the same foot.

name: Outside Touches
description: Tap the ball with the outside of each foot to build cleaner outside-foot contact.

name: Pendulum Roll
description: Roll the ball back and forth across the body like a pendulum, using the sole.

name: Pressure Escape
description: Drag the ball away from a pressing defender, spin, then accelerate into space.

name: Pull-Push
description: Pull the ball back under the body then immediately push it forward through the line.

name: Rainbow Flick
description: Trap the ball between feet, flick it up and over the head with the back of the heel.

name: Rapid V-Pulls
description: Drag the ball back and immediately push at angle, repeating at high tempo.

name: Roll and Cut
description: Roll the ball across the body with the sole, then cut sharply back with the inside.

name: Scissor Feint
description: Step over the ball with one foot in a scissors motion, selling a fake before resetting.

name: Single Foot Balance
description: Lift one foot off the mat while planting the other to develop single-leg stability.

name: Single Step-Over
description: One clean step-over per cycle, selling the fake before pushing the ball away.

name: Sole Roll — Forward & Back
description: Roll the ball from the centre to the top of the mat and back using the sole of your foot. A slow, controlled drill to build confidence with sole contact.

name: Sole Rolls
description: Roll the sole over the top of the ball, switching feet to develop soft control.

name: Sole Transfer
description: Pass the ball under the soles from one foot to the other, building soft control.

name: Speed Shuttle
description: Shuttle the ball left-right at high speed using alternating inside touches.

name: Square Walk
description: Walk a clockwise square through the four corner zones to internalise the grid.

name: Step-Back Push
description: Step backward to draw pressure, then push the ball forward to attack the gap.

name: Step-Over Chain
description: Chain four step-overs together at speed, alternating which foot crosses the ball.

name: Step-Overs
description: Feint over the ball with one foot, then use the other foot's outside touch to push it away and inside touch to bring it back.

name: Stop-Go-Stop
description: Push, stop dead, push again — varying tempo to wrongfoot a defender.

name: Toe Taps
description: Alternate tapping the ball with each foot to build touch sensitivity and rhythm. The ideal first drill for players new to the mat.

name: Triangle Ball Move
description: Move the ball through three zones, returning to home, in a tight triangular path.

name: Triangle Pattern
description: Step through a triangle of three zones to build directional awareness.

name: V-Pull
description: Roll the ball back from the top of the mat with your sole, then redirect it with an outside touch. Builds drag-and-push ball mastery.

name: Zigzag Dribble
description: Push the ball through a zigzag of zones, alternating which foot touches it.
